professionalSummary.text: Is the accountable owner of a fraud-detection model, approving threshold changes.
professionalSummary.witness: Recruiter verification: the former employer's model risk team confirmed in writing that the model inventory lists the candidate as accountable model owner for the card-not-present fraud model from 2022 to 2024.

experienceHighlights.text: Builds fraud features from transaction and authorisation data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built velocity and device-consistency features from authorisation data, tested each on a holdout month and documented each one in the feature catalogue.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Works with fraud operations on rule and alert tuning.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Approved two changes to the decline threshold in 2023 after weekly reviews with the fraud operations manager; both are recorded in the model change log.

skills.text: Presents model performance to the model risk committee.
skills.witness: Presented the half-yearly performance review of the card-not-present model (detection rate, false-positive rate and alert volumes) to the model risk committee, with the threshold history and the changes planned for the next half-year.
